name: voice_ai_bench_ds_gpt
description: A dataset for evaluating voice AI systems (primarily speech synthesis and voice assistant responses) created or augmented using GPT. It measures naturalness, intelligibility, and alignment to prompt intent across a variety of utterances and scenarios and is intended for both automated and human evaluation.
reputation: A niche dataset with limited community adoption, primarily used by its creator and a small set of practitioners evaluating voice AI.
